dogecoin.text:
The Silliest Bubble: Dogecoin

Unlike Bitcoin, dogecoin — a literal joke of a cryptocurrency — is not supply-constrained. If you want more of it, you can mine it — and then sell it, given the profit margin of about 57%.

This is like GameStop but dumber. https://t.co/mE6XBUbyVz
SEC commissioner Hester Peirce says don't complain "to the government if you lose money" investing in joke cryptocurrency Dogecoin that's been on an absolute tear.
